findings.summary: Conformance validity binds only to the PR diff identity and task IDs, so merging a changed plan from main under unchanged task IDs can retain conformance evidence that never checked the current requirements.

Requiring all three vendors to substitute when all bots fail necessarily includes the author's vendor, contradicting §5.3's independence predicate unless substitute records receive an explicit exception.

Excluding evidence files does not establish the promised no-loop guarantee because Gemini still reruns the whole code diff on evidence-only pushes and can emit fresh findings requiring another record commit.

The required invalidation of a passing gate after a late Gemini finding remains delegated to unresolved Plan OPEN point 2, while the specified triggers cannot observe that verdict, leaving a merge-blocking requirement undefined.
